# PhysioCare BD Plus

> PhysioCare BD Plus is a supplier of physiotherapy and rehabilitation equipment in Dhaka, Bangladesh, supplying hospitals, clinics, physiotherapists and individual patients across Bangladesh. Founded by CEO Md. Kamruzzaman Sumon.

Website: https://www.physiocarebdplus.com
Email: sales@physiocarebdplus.com
Phone and WhatsApp: +8801818758882
Address: BMA Bhaban, 15/2 Topkhana Road, Dhaka-1000, Bangladesh
Google Maps listing and reviews: https://g.page/r/CVIruh2GLRzKECE/review
Working hours: Saturday to Thursday 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Friday closed

## What we supply

- TENS and EMS machines
- Ultrasound therapy machines
- Shockwave therapy machines
- Tecar and radio frequency (RF) therapy devices
- Interferential therapy machines
- Traction units
- Infrared therapy lamps
- Shortwave diathermy machines
- Therapy beds and patient examination beds
- Exercise and rehabilitation equipment
- Anatomy and joint models

Prices for most products are listed on the Products page and in the product list below. Stock and warranty are confirmed by the sales team on enquiry. Contact the sales team on WhatsApp at +8801818758882 for a quote.
